values: 30000160 / OWR-782-001; duplicate 30000161 / OWR-782-002: Bannai–Koike–Shinohara–Tagami extremal modular forms modulo p, corrected Conjecture 4 (OWR1/2005, pp.13–14)

Extremal Modular Forms Modulo p and a Conjecture of Bannai, Koike, Shinohara and Tagami — Alper Ferudun (Mercury Software GmbH), v1.0, 2026-10-01. Existing external publication; credit is Ferudun, not Alec Kriebel authorship or a new publication from this sweep. For normalized level-one extremal f_k, even k>=4, whose mod-p reduction is nonconstant and supported on p-divisible exponents, f_k(q)=f_(k′)(q^p) modulo p for integral extremal f_(k′), k′=w(f_k mod p)/p, even 4<=k′<=k/p<k and k′ congruent k modulo p−1. Both parts of corrected Conjecture 4 and duplicate covered with r=1, every intermediate exponent and maximal iteration. Only the reduction is unique, not the characteristic-zero lift or its weight. Corrected printed Case (2) reads p divides a_i for p not dividing i; separate printed Theorem 3 fails at k=12,p=13 and is not fully repaired here. Classical Swinnerton-Dyer/Serre/Deligne inputs credited; no arbitrary-level, arbitrary-coefficient-field or non-extremal-starting-form extension. Seven-page PDF, TeX/source/checker/output ZIP and report verified; stored finite computations are supporting evidence, not a newly replayed universal certificate. AI-assisted, unrefereed preprint; no conventional human peer review, independent discovery or exhaustive historical priority claimed.
